content.text:
I fixed the pricing page on phone-width screens. The three plan cards (Starter, Pro, Team) now stack in one column instead of staying in a three-column grid.

The cause was that `.plans` was missing from the list of grids that collapse to one column below 720px. The FAQ and bundles grids were already in that list. I added `.plans` to it in `site/css/pages.css`.

I checked it in a headless browser at 375px wide. The plans now form a single column and the page no longer scrolls sideways. I didn't look at a screenshot or test on a real phone. The existing functional tests all pass (16 of 16), though they don't cover layout.

I left the "Compare plans" table alone. It's already wrapped so it scrolls sideways on small screens.

I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
